# l2-bpmn-schemas

Knowledge-graph layer L2-BPMN, version 3.0: the interior of a DAK's BPMN files in OMG's vocabulary (definitions, process, participant, task, gateway, event), elaborating L2's external artefact at the same IRI. Imports L2. `l2-bpmn.ts` is the layer as migrated from WHO smart-kg 3f5e477, typed; `index.ts` exports it to the engine in `../../L1/schemas/`, and `generated/` holds the ontology JSON and the JSON-LD context. The FSH goes to the IG's `input/fsh/`.

Part of [SMART Base](../../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `l2-bpmn-schemas`, holding `schemas`, `code`.
